rule: No more than 4 new words per lesson. A sentence is used only when its other words have been met. In round 1, a sentence may appear twice in one lesson if it's in two different types. Use the 4-pair QT01 variant (V0102) when fewer than 5 words are available.
A new word's meaning shows at first sight. On QT01, a wrong tap on a new word isn't a miss.
At least one wrong chip is a contrast from the unit's contrast_sets (un/une, suis/es).
Accept any answer listed in qa_answers for the question.
Speaking questions earn a point but don't count toward the pass. Pass is 70% of graded questions, rounded up.

A miss returns at the end of the lesson as a different type: the same round's type or one round easier (a missed QT12 returns as QT08). A wrong re-ask shows the answer and the lesson moves on; the item stays in the bank.
A missed item also fills one slot in the next lesson, at its original type.
Misses in rounds 2 to 5 go in. Round 1 misses and hinted words don't go in. Hints are still logged.
notes: correction: earlier rule put hinted words in

rule: An item leaves after three correct answers on three different days.
The French plays on every question when the answer bar appears, without blocking Continue.
QT13 says 'native' only where a Lingua Libre recording exists. The native-speaker check before Phase 4 also records the rest.
A swapped question feeds the replacement's skill. The swapped-out skill doesn't move.
No type more than 3 times per lesson, counted before swaps and fallbacks.
1 point per first-attempt correct answer or completed speaking question, shown on home only.
Show only the short hint at A1.
Log how long each lesson takes, by round.

A variant with rounds in use_in_rounds is the only variant of its type used in those rounds. Variants with use_in_rounds empty rotate in any round no listed variant covers. A variant marked for a setting is used only under that setting.

The answer bar shows a rotating line from feedback_phrases for the context, not a fixed Correct or Incorrect. No line repeats back to back. French lines appear at french_feedback_rate and carry the dotted underline for their meaning.
A correct pair animates out together. No green outline. A wrong pair shakes and stays.
A row opens when every unit in the row above has finished round 1. Rounds 2 to 5 of a unit can be done any time after it opens.
A lesson draws only on its own unit's words plus words from units already opened. Names (Paul, Marie) are allowed in any unit.
